payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each problem, compute bitmask. If zero mask, return YES. Else check if complement mask seen, or any previously seen mask has bitwise AND zero. Store seen masks. Works because k≤4.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks pairs of problem bitmasks, leveraging the small k (≤4) to keep the mask space tiny (max 16). It converts each problem to an integer mask, then uses an array to track seen masks and test for disjointness, which is a form of complete search over the possible mask combinations.
